The '''Undercity Transport Station''' was a [[Hovertrain/Legends|hovertram]] station located in the [[Twin Rail District]] of the [[Old World]], on the planet [[Zakuul]]. While looking for the [[SCORPIO|Lady of Sorrows]] during the [[War against Zakuul]], [[Alliance Commander|the Outlander]] and [[Senya Tirall]] took a tram at the Undercity Transport Station to travel from the the Old World to [[District 1327|Breaktown]].<ref name="KotFE 7" />
